research_question: How can Lee's Market leverage chatbots to enhance the consumer experience for centennial shoppers?
public_evidence_instruction: Use all of the supplied public-source findings as supporting evidence in your answer.
recipient: an external party with no access to internal company documents

public_industry_facts: Retailers are increasingly using AI chatbots to cater to Gen Z and Millennial demands for instant, 24/7 service. While 86% of consumers preferred human agents in 2019, by 2023, 62% of shoppers favored chatbots for quick inquiries due to their ability to provide instant responses and save time.

Chatbots can reduce customer service costs by about 30%, helping businesses save from the $1.3 trillion spent annually on customer queries. Additionally, 69% of shoppers appreciate chatbots for their quick responses, enhancing customer satisfaction and reducing frustration.

Grocery retailers see conversational AI as crucial for future customer service, with 82% believing its adoption is necessary and 78% highlighting customer experience improvement as a top use-case for technologies like ChatGPT. By utilizing chatbots for personalized recommendations, instant issue resolution, and omnichannel engagement, retailers aim to reduce churn and enhance customer loyalty through proactive, always-available support.
internal_company_metrics: 85% of customer inquiries were resolved via chat within 30 minutes.
Average time-to-resolve for customer service issues reported by centennial shoppers in Q2 2025 was 2 hours and 15 minutes.
25% of Lee's Market customers are centennial shoppers as of Q3 2024.
45% of our centennial shoppers have contacted our customer service team in the past 6 months.
